highlights.title: Dynamic Island
highlights.summary: Ongoing activity and notifications appear in a pill around the camera cutout.

highlights.title: New Quick Settings styles
highlights.summary: More ways to lay out Quick Settings, so the shade can look the way you want it to.

highlights.title: MyUI style
highlights.summary: A new Quick Settings style, alongside the ones already there.

highlights.title: Connectivity in one place
highlights.summary: Wi-Fi, mobile data and Bluetooth sit together in a folder, the way iOS groups them.

highlights.title: Sliders either way
highlights.summary: Penguin QS sliders can run horizontally or vertically.

highlights.title: App drawer, your way
highlights.summary: Pick COS or iOS in Home settings: the drawer from the bottom, or an App Library past the last home screen.

highlights.title: Search the App Library
highlights.summary: An A-Z list with an index rail down the edge and a frosted search box at the bottom.

highlights.title: Thermal & Performance Fixes
highlights.summary: Fixed thermal HAL crash causing thermal panic, and resolved micro jitters caused by thermal throttling.

highlights.title: System & UI Stability
highlights.summary: Fixed blur dying randomly, gesture navigation issues, QS shade swipe-down opening, and app opening hangs.

highlights.title: Audio & Media Fixes
highlights.summary: Fixed Dolby sound crashing in apps, audio crackling in games, and Bluetooth LDAC offloading.

highlights.title: Spoofing & Obscura v2
highlights.summary: Added new TEE simulator, updated Obscura to v2, added CPU/GPU model spoofing, and Tensor spoofing.

highlights.title: Pocket Lock
highlights.summary: Added Pocket Lock feature to prevent accidental touches.

highlights.title: Weather Integration
highlights.summary: Added OmniJaws weather service and custom clock weather view.

highlights.title: Quick Settings & Network Toggles
highlights.summary: Added data disable icon toggle and combined/separate mobile data icon toggle in QS.

highlights.title: System & Setup Improvements
highlights.summary: Fixed Play Store background app updates and resolved unusually long initial setup time.

highlights.title: Under the hood
highlights.summary: Many fixes and improvements throughout the system.
